results.remarks:
Welcome to the desert lifestyle at its finest in beautiful La Quinta.
An upper-level, end-unit in the highly desirable Palm Royale Country Club offers the perfect blend of comfort, charm, and resort-style living. Tucked away in a private corner of the community, this home offers an exceptional sense of peace and quiet, creating a serene retreat away from the hustle and bustle.
Offered fully furnished, this turnkey 2-bedroom condo is ready for immediate enjoyment. Inside, the living room welcomes you with vaulted ceilings, creating an open and airy feel, while newer windows throughout enhance both energy efficiency and comfort. These windows are fitted with plantation shutters. The kitchen is clean and inviting, featuring crisp white tile countertops, newer stainless steel appliances, and a convenient bar seating area, perfect for casual dining or entertaining.
From the moment you walk in, the home reflects true pride of ownership! It is immaculately maintained and thoughtfully cared for throughout. 
As a corner unit, you’ll enjoy added privacy and abundant natural light! The spacious exterior deck becomes your personal retreat, overlooking the lush golf course and tranquil pond. Whether you're enjoying your morning coffee or unwinding in the evening, this space captures the essence of desert living, complete with an electric awning.
The dining area is ideally positioned to take in golf course views, adding a scenic backdrop to every meal. Both bedrooms are well-appointed with ceiling fans, mirrored sliding closet doors, and plantation shutters, while multiple skylights throughout the home bring in beautiful natural light.
The primary suite features its own private bathroom, ceiling fan, and serene mountain views, creating a peaceful retreat at the end of the day. 
A private laundry room adds everyday convenience, while central heating and air conditioning keep the home comfortable year-round.
The property also includes a detached one-car garage, with ample guest and curbside parking available throughout the community.
Living in Palm Royale means enjoying an unmatched list of amenities included in the HOA: Unlimited golf, internet, cable TV, tennis courts, pools and spas, pickleball, frisbee golf, fitness center, library, security, and more, truly a lifestyle, not just a home. The HOA allows rentals of 30+ days. 
If you’ve been looking for a low-maintenance, move-in ready property with incredible views and resort-style amenities, this is the one.

results.remarks: Simply Enchanting! Within the gates of 55+ Trilogy at La Quinta and Golf Club, this delightful Maurea model two bedroom, two baths home rests on large 9,148 square foot raised lot overlooking towering mountain vistas and spectacular sunsets from the front courtyard, and peak-a-boo mountain views from the spacious private backyard. The home is bright and cheerful with an open floorplan, tile floors, nine-foot ceilings, ceiling fans throughout, and a wall of windows that overlooks a large covered patio and a brilliantly colored and meticulously landscaped yard with a bubbling fountain. Electric awnings, solar shades and a newer air conditioner keep the home cool and comfortable year-round. Low maintenance and easy comfort make it the perfect resort home.  In the great room, the stack stone media wall with flat screen TV, and linear electric fireplace with colorful dancing flames is the perfect place to stream your favorite shows and cheer your teams to victory. The kitchen is a delight, featuring quality custom cabinets, custom travertine backsplash and slab granite on the counters and breakfast bar. The dining area off the kitchen is steps from sliding doors to the back covered patio. The primary bedroom suite is spacious with large windows overlooking the backyard, and a private door to the back patio. The primary bath features double sinks, a cultured marble countertop, tile floors, shower, a walk-in closet, and additional mirrored closet. The guest bedroom is roomy and adjacent to a full bath with custom lighting. The two-car garage is extended by four feet and fits two cars side-by-side, and a golf cart. Trilogy at La Quinta is a 55+ active adult community with a newly renovated 18-hole Gary Panks resort golf course open to the public, a driving range, putting green, Kitchen Ten-Eleven Restaurant, and a Pro-Shop. Within the 24/7 guarded gates, the residents enjoy Tennis, PickleBall, Bocce, large outdoor pool, spa and cabanas, and separate lap pool, the Coral Mountain Spa, a fitness center, grand ballroom, a Cafe Solaz with yummy food and a full bar, and year-round activities and events too many to count. By far, Trilogy is one of the Best Values in all the Coachella Valley.

results.remarks: Move in ready and beautifully updated, this 4 bedroom, 2 bathroom home offers 1,286 square feet of comfortable living space in the heart of La Quinta, one of the Coachella Valley's most sought after cities. Renovated throughout, it pairs modern style with an unbeatable location.Inside, the remodeled kitchen anchors the home with updated countertops, cabinetry, and appliances built for cooking and entertaining. Newer flooring and light fixtures carry through the open living areas, an updated HVAC system keeps things comfortable year-round, and both bathrooms have been refreshed with clean, contemporary finishes.But the real story here is the lifestyle right outside your door. You're within walking distance of Old Town La Quinta, where Spanish Mission style streets are lined with boutique shopping, art galleries, and some of the valley's best restaurants, plus a beloved weekly farmers market. Outdoor lovers will appreciate being minutes from La Quinta's scenic hiking and trail systems along the Cove and Santa Rosa foothills, with routes for everyone from casual morning walkers to serious desert trekkers.When you want more, everything the desert is known for is a short drive away: world class golf at PGA West, La Quinta Resort, and Indian Wells, fishing and lakeside recreation at Lake Cahuilla, the Coachella and Stagecoach music festivals in nearby Indio, and a quick trip to Acrisure Arena for concerts, hockey, and marquee events. Add in year round sunshine and premier shopping and dining, and this is desert living at its most convenient.Whether you're after a full time residence, a seasonal getaway, or a smart investment in a proven rental market, this La Quinta gem checks every box. Come see it before it's gone.

results.remarks: Welcome to 61000 Living Stone Drive, a beautifully situated home in the highly sought-after 55+ community of Trilogy La Quinta, where resort-style amenities, spectacular mountain scenery and an active social lifestyle come together for exceptional desert living. This inviting Maurea floor plan offers approximately 1,386 square feet with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a 2-car garage, along with a bright, open great-room design that flows seamlessly between the kitchen, dining and living areas. The kitchen features slab granite countertops and backsplash, maple cabinetry, a breakfast bar, pantry, gas cooktop and built-in microwave, creating a comfortable space for both everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary suite includes a walk-in closet, dual vanities and a generous walk-in shower with bench seating, while the separate guest bedroom and bath provide privacy for family and friends. Outside, enjoy a wonderful golf course setting with beautiful lake and mountain views, a covered patio and plenty of space to relax, entertain and take in La Quinta's unforgettable sunsets. Cafe Solaz provides another casual option for dining and meeting friends within the community. Whether your ideal day includes golf, pickleball, a workout, relaxing by the pool, meeting friends for lunch or simply enjoying the peaceful views from your own backyard, 61000 Living Stone Drive offers a wonderful opportunity to experience the very best of the Trilogy La Quinta lifestyle.

The inviting living room features a fireplace, creating a comfortable space to relax or gather with family and friends.Step outside to the covered Alumawood patio with manual shades, offering a welcoming setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or enjoying the surrounding views. Additional highlights include a newer water heater, two-car garage, and the convenience of being mostly furnished.Conveniently located near shopping, dining, golf, and everyday services near Fred Waring and Jefferson, with additional retail centers only minutes away. Whether you are seeking a full-time residence or seasonal desert retreat, this home offers an opportunity to enjoy the La Quinta lifestyle.

results.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained home in the highly desirable gated community of Parc La Quinta. Situated on an oversized corner lot, this spacious residence offers the perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and desert lifestyle living. Featuring approximately 2,004 square feet of living space, the home boasts an open and inviting floor plan, generous living areas, and seamless indoor-outdoor living ideal for entertaining or relaxing poolside.The private backyard retreat is designed for true desert living, featuring a sparkling pool and spa, breathtaking mountain views, and mature landscaping that creates a sense of privacy and tranquility. Whether you're  taking in the surrounding mountain scenery or entertaining family and friends under the desert sky, this outdoor space offers the perfect balance of openness and seclusion.Inside, you'll find spacious bedrooms, well-appointed bathrooms, and a layout designed for both everyday living and hosting guests.Parc La Quinta is a charming gated neighborhood known for its central location and low HOA dues. Residents enjoy convenient access to premier golf courses, hiking and biking trails, shopping, dining, and entertainment throughout La Quinta and the surrounding desert communities. Located just minutes from Old Town La Quinta, homeowners can enjoy boutique shopping, local restaurants, community events, and the popular farmers market. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate nearby recreation opportunities at Fritz Burns Park and the Fred Wolff Bear Creek Nature Preserve. The home is also ideally situated just minutes from the world-renowned Indian Wells Tennis Garden and Acrisure Arena, offering year-round access to professional tennis tournaments, concerts, sporting events, and live entertainment. Everyday conveniences, including grocery stores, shopping centers, and dining options, are all within easy reach, making this location one of the most desirable in the Coachella Valley.Whether you're searching for a full time residence, seasonal getaway, or investment opportunity, this exceptional La Quinta property offers the best of desert living in one of the area's most convenient and sought after locations.

results.remarks: RARE OPPORTUNITY IN DUNA LA QUINTA!  Location, location, location... and exceptional value. Enjoy panoramic 180-degree lake, golf course, and Santa Rosa Mountain views from this ideally positioned home overlooking the 10th fairway of the Pete Dye Dunes Course. Southern exposure provides spectacular sunrises, vibrant sunsets. The versatile floor plan features a detached casita, and the second bedroom with its own entrance means it can be locked off from the rest of the house, creating interesting rental management options. The home is offered priced AS IS, turnkey furnished. This is a rare opportunity for a buyer to personalize and update to their own taste, while securing an outstanding location at an attractive price point. Whether you're seeking a primary residence, seasonal retreat, investment property, or rental income opportunity, the possibilities are numerous. The original bathrooms and finishes offer a blank canvas for modernization, while the home's layout, views, and location provide an exceptional foundation for future value. Duna La Quinta is a gated enclave, in close proximity to the legendary La Quinta Resort. Residents enjoy easy access to world-class golf, tennis, pickleball, dining, shopping, hiking, Old Town La Quinta, and the area's renowned music and art festivals. Properties with this combination of views, floor plan, two locked off rooms, and ''close-to-everything'' location rarely come available at this price. 100% livable today while bringing your vision to make this exceptional property your very own. After renovation values of $929K - $1.4M comparable properties in the past few years suggest a large margin for your improvements. PS. I love this house. As agents, we don't always love all of our listings but I'd live here!!

results.remarks: Welcome to Esplanade, a prestigious gated community in the heart of La Quinta, where refined design meets the relaxed sophistication of desert living. This impeccably maintained residence offers an effortless blend of comfort, elegance, and resort-style living in one of the Coachella Valley's most desirable locations.A light-filled open floor plan with soaring ceilings and expansive windows creates a sense of space and serenity throughout. With over $200,000 in pre and post closing upgrades, there's a lot to appreciate in the finer details. The chef's kitchen anchors the home with sleek quartz countertops, premium finishes, and a substantial island designed for both intimate mornings and elevated entertaining.The living spaces transition seamlessly outdoors to a private backyard retreat featuring a shimmering pool and spa, framed by breathtaking mountain views. Whether hosting under the stars around the fire pit or enjoying quiet afternoons in the sun, this outdoor oasis delivers true desert luxury.The home features three generously sized bedrooms and three refined baths, including a tranquil primary suite with an oversized walk-in closet and direct access to the patio through elegant French doors. A dedicated office or flexible living space adds versatility for modern lifestyles, while the three-car garage and curated upgrades throughout enhance both form and function.Esplanade offers a prime location just moments from world-class golf, tennis and pickleball, upscale shopping and dining, the Acrisure Arena, and the  charm of Old Town La Quinta.Ideal as a full-time residence, seasonal escape, or investment opportunity, this exceptional home embodies elevated desert living at its finest. Private showings available--experience it for yourself.

results.remarks: Nestled behind the gates of The Enclave at Capistrano, this highly upgraded 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers 2,529 sq. ft. of exceptional indoor-outdoor living. The open-concept floor plan features soaring ceilings, 8-foot doors, abundant natural light, designer lighting, two-tone paint, wood shutters, and premium finishes throughout. The chef’s kitchen showcases a large quartz island, custom lighting, ample cabinetry, Bosch refrigerator, and a stunning Restoration Hardware chandelier in the adjoining dining area. A versatile bonus space provides the perfect setting for a home office, fitness room, study, or creative retreat. The spacious primary suite features a spa-inspired bath with a large glass-enclosed shower, dual vanities, and oversized walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms share a beautifully appointed bath. The private backyard is an entertainer’s dream, featuring a newly constructed pebble-finish pool and spa with Baja shelf and four water features, motorized pergola with adjustable vented roof, built-in Bull BBQ island with refrigerator, covered California Room, low-maintenance landscaping, and ambient landscape lighting. Additional highlights include a finished 2-car garage with epoxy flooring, tandem parking or storage, Samsung washer and dryer, whole-home smart technology including a Honeywell smart thermostat and SkyBell video doorbell, and a TAEXX in-wall pest defense system built directly into the home’s walls, providing convenient, zero-contact pest protection. Enjoy mountain views from the finished front courtyard and a prime location just minutes from championship golf, upscale dining, shopping, and resort amenities. With a low HOA of just $200, this is an exceptional opportunity to own one of The Enclave at Capistrano’s finest homes in one of La Quinta’s most desirable gated communities.

results.remarks: Welcome to Paradise in Trilogy La Quinta! This stunning turnkey furnished  Maurea model offers 2BD/2BA, 1,386 SF of bright, open resort-style living in one of the desert’s most sought-after 55+ gated communities. This beautifully updated home offers unobstructed west-facing mountain views, standout curb appeal, and a warm, welcoming feel from the moment you arrive. No monthly HOA, and located in the lower-cost IID electric district. Great updates, gorgeous surroundings, and a price that makes this home worth seeing!Some listing images include AI-generated furnishings or digital enhancements and are provided to help buyers imagine the possibilities.

results.remarks: Set within La Quinta Cove, this newly constructed modern residence by award-winning GHA Companies offers a refined yet livable approach to desert architecture. The design is clean and contemporary, shaped by light, proportion, and an easy sense of flow that feels natural rather than forced. From the entry, the home opens into a bright, expansive great room where living, dining, and kitchen spaces connect as one continuous environment. Tall ceilings and an open layout with integrated speakers throughout create a sense of volume and calm, allowing the home to breathe. Large sliding glass doors extend the interior to a covered patio and a low-maintenance, drought-conscious landscape, creating a natural transition between indoor and outdoor living. Located just minutes from Old Town La Quinta and moments from world-class dining, golf, shopping, resorts, and entertainment, this home offers a modern desert lifestyle defined by design, comfort, and long-term livability.
